text:
maria: Quick IA spike  thinking of grouping the left nav into: Workspaces, Assets, and Observability. All other links become contextual flyouts. Goal: faster scanning and cleaner deep links. reactions?

sam: Good direction. One thing: breadcrumbs need to be deterministicusers paste links into tickets/automation.

lina: +1. Breadcrumbs should use the canonical resource path (org/project/model) and prefer slugs over UI labels so they remain stable if labels change.

alex: On routing, prefer full-path routes like `/orgs/:org/projects/:proj/assets/:assetId` and keep hashes for ephemeral UI toggles only. Also avoid encoding panel state into the path.

maria: Example: `https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/redwood/projects/pioneer/assets/rosetta-7b?view=metrics`. Hash only for transient UI like `#help=open`.

ethan: Accessibility: when hiding items, ensure keyboard users can reach the flyout triggers predictably. Flyouts must announce when opened with aria-live and focus should move into the flyout panel.

sam: UX question: if someone clicks a nested item inside a collapsed group, should we expand the group or navigate while keeping the group collapsed?

lina: I vote navigate while keeping compact state, but show a small visual cue that indicates where the item lives (e.g., a fade-in badge: "in Workspaces > Assets"). Announce via `aria-live=polite`.

alex: Migration note: we need a lightweight router shim that maps old hash-style routes to canonical full-paths. Keep the shim active for a migration window (recommend 4-6 months) and emit telemetry when the shim handles a route.

maria: How do we track coverage?

ethan: Log legacy hits with `legacy_route=true` and surface counts in a dashboard. Also include the original requested URL so we can author new mappings for edge cases.

prod-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/compact-ia-workspaces (preview/compact-ia-workspaces)  includes shim + accessibility hooks.

sam: I'll audit the preview tomorrow. Checklist: 1) tab order 2) focus on redirect 3) aria announcements 4) keyboard expand/collapse behavior.

lina: Copy nit: prefer short labels. "Assets" reads better than "Models" or "Model hub" in tight widths, but breadcrumbs should still show full resource titles.

maria: Bookmark policy: canonical path + a small set of documented query params only (e.g., `?eval=123&view=metrics`). Avoid serializing ephemeral panel UI. If users explicitly choose "share view" we'll snapshot panel state in a stable share token, not raw UI state.

alex: Agreed. Also when we programmatically redirect legacy -> canonical, call `mainHeading.focus()` and set `document.title` so screen reader users keep orientation.

ethan: Also propose small a11y affordance: when a flyout opens because of a keyboard action, include a dismiss link that is the first tabbable element so users can exit quickly.

sam: One last ask: expose a compact-mode query param (`?nav=compact`) for power users so they can opt in without changing account settings.

maria: Nice idea. We'll add that to the contract to review. Next steps: 1) ship preview to design + a11y 2) eng to add legacy route logging 3) product to finalize allowed query params 4) design to iterate microcopy on the compact labels.

prod-bot: preview build passed smoke tests (1/1).
